headline: One picture, 158 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 158 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 158 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 3 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.006 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): b69d4a49e858 on 147 works, b40a55b3947b on 11 works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (158).
These works are spread over 4 blocks: Dakore, Kadaura, Kuthaund, Maheva.
